title: Evaluation of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 for supporting real-world information needs in healthcare delivery
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark was focused on the safety and concordance of LLM responses to real-world clinical questions in healthcare.
findings: There were no findings related to religion as this topic was not a part of the study.
